title: UniversalRouteTable
description: Universal routing table schema for mikomai and configuration management

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the routing table was generated

source_device.description: The hostname or device name from which the routing table was retrieved

os_type.description: The operating system or device type, e.g., macos, windows, linux, cisco_ios, junos, routeros, etc.

destination.description: The destination IP address, network, or 'default'

gateway.description: The gateway IP address or interface link name

flags.description: Routing flags (e.g., U, G, H, etc.)

interface.description: The network interface associated with the route
